description: `LockService` provides server-local, non-queued locks identified by an owner `Instance` and string key. `ActionExecutionService` always uses the action's actor as this owner, so action locks never contend across different players.

LockPermit.luau.description: Represents exclusive ownership of one owner/key lock until explicit release, timeout, or owner/holder destruction. Public entry points include `LockPermit.new`, `LockPermit.GetOwner`, `LockPermit.GetKey`, `LockPermit.GetHolder`, `LockPermit.IsReleased`, `LockPermit.GetReleaseReason`, `LockPermit.Release`, `LockPermit.Destroy`.

LockService.luau.description: Coordinates non-queued, non-reentrant locks identified by an owner Instance and key. Public entry points include `LockService.Init`, `LockService.TryAcquire`, `LockService.RunAsync`, `LockService.IsLocked`, `LockService.Destroy`.

LockServiceTypes.luau.description: Shared contracts for keyed server lock acquisition.

LockServiceUtils.luau.description: Validates keyed lock configuration and identifiers. Public entry points include `LockServiceUtils.isTimeout`, `LockServiceUtils.isLockKey`, `LockServiceUtils.isReason`, `LockServiceUtils.isAcquireConfig`.
